sentences.en: This man I forbid any one to receive or address.
sentences.zh: 我禁止任何人接受或回应这个人。

sentences.en: These young'uns broke the law that forbids breaking the law.
sentences.zh: 这些年轻人违反了那条禁止违法的法律。

sentences.en: The law forbids the building of any skyscraper on this land.
sentences.zh: 法律规定不得在这片土地上建造任何摩天大楼。

senses.zh: 禁止；不准；不允许；〈正式〉严禁

mnemonic: for（前）+bid（出价）→预先出价→阻止（别人）
